assets.record_shape: array under key 'assets'; alias_map resolves names/tickers → slug

score_fields.peg_mechanism_score: Axis 1 (six-axis frame) - peg mechanism soundness. Legacy reports carry volatility_score instead.
score_fields.volatility_score: Axis 1 (legacy frame) - price stability / peg volatility. Six-axis reports carry peg_mechanism_score instead.
score_fields.backing_score: Axis 2 - reserve backing quality and coverage. Present on six-axis reports.
score_fields.liquidity_score: Axis 3 - on-chain exit depth (observed, not TVL).
score_fields.underlying_score: Axis 4 - dependencies: the counterparty and upstream-protocol set the asset relies on but does not control.
score_fields.structural_score: Axis 5 - CONTRACT & ADMIN authority: upgrade paths, timelocks, key control and quorum. NOT a backing measure.
score_fields.issuer_score: Axis 6 - issuer / counterparty trust (present when a distinct issuer is assessed).
score_fields.redemption_score: COMPONENT INPUT, not a peer axis - ability to redeem to underlying at par. Six-axis reports fold redemption into liquidity on the worse-leg rule, so this is a finer-grained input rather than a competing verdict.
score_fields.overall_score: Blended asset risk score. AUTHORED, not derived from the axes -- do not expect it to equal their mean.

protocols.record_shape: array under key 'protocols'; alias_map resolves names → slug

notes: default_scores apply to every chain; chain_scores overrides per chain.
report_file is a path into the private source repo, not a public URL.
issuer_score appears on assets only where a distinct issuer is assessed.

TWO FRAMES COEXIST: legacy records carry volatility_score/redemption_score; six-axis records carry peg_mechanism_score, backing_score and underlying_score. Read the fields present rather than assuming a fixed set.

structural_score is CONTRACT & ADMIN authority, not backing. Backing is backing_score. This description was wrong until 2026-09-10. If you built against the old description, the two fields DISPERSE rather than differ by a constant: across 22 assets publishing both, 8 have structural above backing, 9 below and 5 equal, mean signed gap -0.18, worst over-read +3.5. THERE IS NO CORRECTION FACTOR - each affected asset must be re-read individually.
overall_score is AUTHORED, not computed from the other axes; it will not equal their mean.
generated_at advances on every publish, including no-op heartbeats; use it to tell a live feed from a stopped one.
content_changed_at moves only when assets.json or protocols.json actually differ; use it to tell whether the DATA is new.
